measurement_cautions: Original cap1/cap2 variants changed ALL four street caps because a scratch text replacement matched preflop as well as flop. Actual caps are retained per record; these are not postflop-only sensitivity results.
The corrected variants anchor full field names and assert parsed preflop=4; original raw inputs and hashes were not overwritten.
Preflight records with complete=false are traversed prefixes at the memory budget, not total counts.
Wall times may include competing local preflights, audits, and test/build processes; no rigorous speedup claim follows.
Finite fixed-candidate held-out gains do not certify exploitability or Nash equilibrium.
Node action rates include physical card removal and prefix reach. Fallback fractions and Monte Carlo error remain explicit.
